issuer.entity: Liquity protocol debt; Liquity AG software/website role, no established corporate redemption obligor
issuer.summary: Issuer 8.0 is retained provisionally within the protocol-side counterparty rubric. No corporate reserve manager or guaranteed corporate redemption debtor was established. This limits discretionary reserve-manager exposure but does not remove code, oracle, LST, governance, developer-conduct or frontend risk. Owner renunciation belongs to the contract axis, not independent issuer-score credit. Historical public issue/redeployment response retains its dates; no full current incident or legal recovery assurance was obtained.
facts: Swiss software developer Liquity AG publishes the protocol documentation and identifies Samrat Lekhak as CEO, Rick Pardoe as lead engineer and Bingen Eguzkitza as head of development. The company disclaims operation of the protocol. Independent operators run frontends. No corporate repayment undertaking was identified.

LQTY stakers direct Protocol Liquidity Incentives, funded with 25% of protocol revenue. Liquity documents the core contracts as immutable. This allocation power gives voters no documented authority to change BOLD redemption terms or upgrade the core.

Any BOLD holder can request protocol redemption for a routed mix of WETH, wstETH and rETH, less a dynamic fee. Cash proceeds depend on execution and selling the collateral. Liquity’s disclaimer describes the functionality as technical and disclaims claims against individuals or entities. Swiss law and Zug courts govern website disputes. No corporate cash redemption right, insolvency priority or independently established legal recovery was identified.

In February 2025 the team disclosed a Stability Pool issue, urged users to exit the original deployment, and arranged fixes, external review and a public audit competition. The patched deployment launched May 19, 2025. This is evidence of public coordination and redeployment. No new core incident or compensation commitment was identified in the reviewed official updates since November 11. The separately operated sBOLD wrapper and its loss are outside the BOLD core incident record.

Liquity lists external code reviews, formal verification, the Cantina competition and a May 2025 fixes review. These cover specified code and periods. No issuer financial-statement audit, independent current reserve opinion or holder payout guarantee was identified. Current deployed-code assurance, collateral balances and executable exit capacity require separate evidence.
issuer.summary_source: DeFiAnalyst exact Liquity BOLD Ethereum component, documentary review November 27. No material documented issuer change since November 11.
issuer.producer_note: Existing production report URL is retained; November11candidate refresh is not deployed. Full-report clocks and original per-field source dates are preserved.
